answer: Neighborhood Diversity Floor: each identity's reach is capped unless its transaction graph shows mutually independent neighbors across separate regions. Every new link is a voyage outward; agents earn capacity only when those paths terminate in distinct clusters. An attacker must provision a sable span of isolated subgraphs, each seeded and sustained separately, and keep them synchronized through every reward dawn. Cost scales with the number of disjoint topologies maintained, not with a single payment.
